domestic_evidence: No public domestic-supply record located. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report domestic/export splits were not retrievable: zaubacorp page returned HTTP 403 and the web_search backend returned connection errors on all queries, so no GST or tender source could be read. Domestic supply is therefore not confirmed and not denied — null, not public in the sources reachable within this check.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records show outbound inkjet printing inks (HS 32151990 / 32151190) from Ahmedabad Air and Nhava Sheva Sea to Dubai/Jebel Ali (UAE), Moscow Domodedovo (Russia) and, in the second entity record, to Desert Sign Trading LLC and Pearl Ink. Declared HS 321590 is a parent heading of the observed 32151990/32151190 — consistent, no correction needed. Two related legal-name variants appear in customs data (GLOBEX LABORATORIES (R&D) LIMITED, Padra and GLOBEX LABORATORIES (RD) LIMITED, Goregaon East) and share the same counterparties (Pearl Ink, Desert Sign, All Prints Technologies, Best Color), so they are treated as the same group; the batch entity matches the Padra record. Note the company is also an importer (Miwon Specialty Chemical, Nanjing Skyfly, Lubrizol, Shandong Jiayuan), i.e. it converts imported raw materials into inks — a manufacturer_trader profile, not a pure trader. Domestic India supply evidence is missing only because the search backend was unavailable, not because it was disproven; recommend a follow-up GST/GeM check. No revenue or export-volume figures are public in the free views, so those remain null.
